archetypes.name: dyn-proposal-wording
archetypes.rationale: Checks that the prompt change forces complete append-ready proposal text without widening unrelated report sections.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the learn-from-bugs Step 4 wording. Confirm sections 4 through 6 require complete append-ready proposals, including lint suppression and baseline policy, invariant best-home detail, full rule-file drafts, and complete guideline sentences. Also check that sections 1, 2, 3, and 7 remain unchanged and that the brevity carve-out stays local to proposal wording. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
